title: Fritz Pollard enters early pro football
description: Fritz Pollard became one of the earliest Black players in the NFL era.

title: Fritz Pollard becomes NFL head coach
description: Pollard became the first African American head coach in NFL history.

title: Fritz Pollard plays quarterback
description: Pollard is recognized as the first Black quarterback in NFL history.

title: Marlin Briscoe starts at quarterback
description: Briscoe became the first Black starting quarterback in modern pro football.

title: Doug Williams wins Super Bowl XXII
description: Williams became the first Black quarterback to start and win a Super Bowl and was named MVP.

title: Tony Dungy and Lovie Smith reach Super Bowl
description: Dungy and Smith became the first Black head coaches to face each other in a Super Bowl.

title: Mahomes and Hurts start Super Bowl LVII
description: Super Bowl LVII became the first Super Bowl with two Black starting quarterbacks.
